source_extracts.label: FedEx — returns policy (archived snapshot, bot-wall)
source_extracts.quote: Can I return UPS packages or USPS packages at a FedEx location? No. Only FedEx shipments can be processed at a FedEx location.

source_extracts.label: UPS — official drop-off options
source_extracts.quote: UPS drop-off options: The UPS Store, UPS Customer Centers, UPS Drop Boxes, and UPS Access Points at participating retailers. No post office appears on the list.

source_extracts.label: Mailbox Plus counter QR programs (owner ruling)
source_extracts.quote: QR scanning IS offered for FedEx Easy Returns, Happy Returns, USPS Label Broker. Amazon returns: pre-printed carrier label ONLY, no Amazon QR codes.

numeric_claims.scope: Four major carriers at one counter (UPS, FedEx, USPS, DHL) — serviceAreas copy
Scene narrative clock ('11 p.m.') — figurative, not a service-hours claim
Ordered-list markers ('1.') and word 'one' in narrative idioms ('in one stop') — structural/figurative, not a quantity claim
Comparative narrative ('the FedEx store is two minutes closer') — figurative drive-time flavor, not a measured route claim
Narrative anecdote ('saved you ten minutes of driving') — figurative, not a measured route claim

scope_rules.reason: Article makes no pricing claims; any dollar figure would be unverified.
Amazon returns are label-only (Decision Log 2026-11-20); QR mentions must carry the named-programs scope + Amazon exception.
